name: Blue Realm
description: Thane's turquoise amulet used to cast spells such as summoning Nightmares.

timeline.summary: Thane stumbled into Everlorne and used Nightmares summoned with the Blue Realm to kill a horned octopus in a whirlwind.
timeline.quote: Thane used his amulet to summon two Nightmares to fight the octopus.
